request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Fenneedle Heron".

Creative brief
Name: Fenneedle Heron
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A precise ranged hunter that fires thin but clearly spaced needle lines.
Body and silhouette: Tall wading bird with extremely long legs, folded wings, and a straight spear-like beak.
Signature features: Reed-feather crest, needle bundle beneath one wing, and a dark throat stripe.
Palette and materials: Fog gray, reed green, faded blue, and pale tan.
Movement personality: Still, elegant, and lightning-fast when striking.
Attack concept: Points its beak with a bright line telegraph before firing a rapid sequence of three reed needles down the same lane.
Directional details: A broken reed is tied beneath the left wing.
Avoid: Realistic feather detail, stork proportions, nearly invisible one-pixel projectiles.
